description: Eleven native search invocations captured 295 ordered headers across Georgian and English language terms and broad/midmonth/later-month queries. English searches sometimes surfaced the U.S. state of Georgia; those results were excluded. Open-web discovery is not a LexisNexis-equivalent systematic search, the Georgian regional press sample is incomplete, and this unit cannot establish absence of other events. Official baseline/schema verification is still pending.
required_followup: Coordinator review should inspect capture/source coverage, compare the official baseline when available, and pursue Georgian local and sector-specific archives without treating zero results as no event.
